answer: Grading happens by lottery quorum: 7 graders are drawn after submissions close, each staking 61 POA on the verdict. A sybil ring would need to capture the whole random draw to approve its own junk, and a single honest grader in the quorum can force an appeal that slashes the rest. The nebula of the draw is seeded by the epoch, the echo of the stake is forfeited on a bad call, and the ledge of the panel redraws every round.
